analysis.sampling: Every decoded native frame in presentation order; no interpolation or FPS conversion.
analysis.geometry: Full coded image resized to 192x128; no crop, padding, or autorotation. Bounds are normalized to that image.
analysis.units: MAE and luminance use grayscale code values in [0,255], not physical light measurements.

definitions.adjacentMAE: Pixel mean absolute error between consecutive frames; values[i] compares frames i and i+1.
definitions.seamMAE: Pixel mean absolute error between the actual final decoded frame and the first frame.
definitions.seamToMedianAdjacentRatio: Seam MAE divided by median adjacent MAE; null when the denominator is zero.
definitions.staticDriftFromFirstMAE: Pixel MAE against the first frame for every later frame; includes motion, lighting and compression changes.
definitions.frameMeanLuminance: Mean grayscale per frame; range is maximum minus minimum of those means.

limitations: Descriptive metrics only: no universal quality pass/fail threshold, and metrics cannot prove visual quality or a seamless loop.
Fixed regions assume atlas framing; inspect their placement if the composition changes. The bridge sample is particularly small.
Downscaled grayscale misses color changes and fine artifacts. Drift is not a geometric displacement estimate.
Adjacent differences depend on native frame cadence; compare FPS and framing when comparing clips. Audio is metadata-only.
